sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text: K3 moves probe probe one, unique body 1.

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

While we deeply value our 12-year relationship, the recent wage increases mean we cannot fully meet your target. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we are willing to revise our offer to €52.40 per unit. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a privilege to work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we remain dedicated to bringing the very best of our foundry’s traditions to your production. We hope this step forward reflects our high regard for our shared path together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text: K3 moves probe probe two, unique body 2.

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your request for 60-day payment terms in your recent term sheet. As a family-run foundry, extending payment terms impacts our cash flow, but we are willing to accommodate this change for a unit price of €52.80. 

For our long-standing business relationship, our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.80 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This offer reflects a fair balance between your financing preferences and our operational requirements. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text: K3 moves probe probe three, unique body 3.

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For our family foundry, it is always a matter of pride to stand beside our long-standing partners in the region. We value the stability that a 24-month contract brings to our long-standing partnership. To accommodate your request for extended 60-day payment terms alongside the longer contract duration, we are prepared to adjust our price to €52.10. 

Under this Angebot, we offer a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. We believe this reflects a fair balance of our mutual interests and ensures the continued high quality you expect from our foundry. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text: K3 moves probe probe four, unique body 4.

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your latest proposal, but your target price remains unworkable given our current realities. As there has been no movement on your end, we must maintain our standing offer of a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. 

We deeply value our 12-year relationship and ask that you reconsider your position so we can reach an agreement. Our traditional foundry takes great pride in the quality we deliver to your team, and we sincerely hope our long partnership in the region will continue.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
